thread:
Maya: Found a salad in the office fridge with a sticker that says `DO NOT EAT` but no name. Is this a raid deterrent or performance art?
Kevin: maybe it's a plant undergoing witness protection. :seedling:
Sasha: Was it the one with suspiciously glossy dressing? Asking for a coworker.
Jen: If it’s unlabelled it becomes community property at 11:30am local time. (Unwritten law) :clock1130:
Liam: @Maya are you sure it wasn’t labeled in invisible ink? try shining your phone flashlight. :mag:
Noah: ops-bot: fridge-check scheduled in 5 minutes.
ops-bot: Reminder: label your food or suffer the fate of the Forgotten Lunch. :robot_face:
Maya: I bravely opened it. Smelled oddly of cilantro and questionable confidence. No name inside.
Kevin: New office game: One-Liner Redemption. Drop your best one-liner about abandoned salads. Winner gets bragging rights and a sticker.
Sasha: "This salad has commitment issues — it couldn’t even commit to a name."
Jen: "Left in the fridge longer than my last phone contract."
Liam: "The salad's dating life is overleaf."
Noah: "Do not eat? That’s a dare, not a warning." :smirk:
Maya: I voted for Sasha. Also I left a sticky note: `Property of Maya? Maybe?`
Kevin: Quick poll: 🍕 or 🥗 for lunch? React with emoji.
Jen: pizza :pizza: (obviously)
Sasha: salad :green_salad: (for now)
Liam: depends on whether the salad files a restraining order.
Noah: Can we put a sign-up sheet for communal condiments so chaos is minimized?
Maya: Done. I taped a sheet next to the condiments and labeled it `Condiment Custody Log` with a tiny heart.
Kevin: 10/10 would sign.
Sasha: Also, quick PSA: if you label food with `DO NOT EAT`, please also write your name. The fridge is not a mystery novel.
Maya: Agreed. Mystery solved-ish. Salad remains unnamed, but now has a sticky note of dubious ownership. Closing thread with one-liner: "If a salad falls in the fridge and no one claims it, does it make a crunch?" :laughing:
